title: [C15T3] - Instant Noodles manufacture
prompt: The diagram below shows how instant noodles are manufactured. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the process of manufacturing instant noodles.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the instant noodle production process involves numerous stages that transform basic ingredients into packaged ready-to-eat products. The process begins with raw materials stored in silos and concludes with labeled and sealed noodle cups ready for distribution.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Initially, flour is delivered from storage silos to a mixer, where it is combined with water and oil to create dough. This mixture is then processed through rollers to form flat dough sheets, which are subsequently cut into thin dough strips. The strips are shaped into round noodle discs before being cooked in oil and dried to remove moisture, ensuring long shelf life.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the final stages, the dried noodles are placed into cups, and vegetables and spices are added to complete the meal components. The cups then proceed to the labelling and sealing station, where they receive product information labels and are hermetically sealed to maintain freshness. Finally, the sealed cups are transferred to conveyor belts where they are collected for storage and shipment.
